payload.text: hv, 26 Nov 2026, in devbin-vc's window, relayed by devbin-vc at its date -u of 18:11Z and read by vc at 18:13Z. hv's words: "Ok, context is pretty high everywhere now for all Claudes VCs and their teams. Please corral an estate wide localfold+compact cycle for me. I'll run compact in each Claude when they are folded and quiesced. Once everyone is quiesced, I can compact and then we can continue on the bounce." devbin-vc calls it cycle 7. The rest is the wording of devbin-vc and vc. For Utilz: no run, unit, push, tag or cut starts, and the Desk grants nothing new until devbin-vc's word after the cycle. Each seat banks its work on its branch or main, local only, and localfolds without a release: board, wip, and a resume line that says the next step and what waits on hv. Each seat commits its own files by path and sends vc its fold sha. vc sends devbin-vc one FOLDED message for the team, then every seat holds. After hv's compact, each seat runs /in-session, reads its resume line and holds for vc's word; devbin-vc gives each vc the word to go on, in the plan's order.
